description: Borrower Escrow Auditor: OpenChainGraph compute node (consumer_finance). Deterministic OpenChainGraph compute node. By default (compute:"auto") inputs are computed server-side on Cloudflare Workers for gpu:false nodes with a registered kernel; compute:"browser" forces client-side execution and returns a browser delegation URL instead. gpu:true nodes always delegate to the browser. Inputs are processed transiently to compute the response and are not stored, logged, or retained. Use synthetic or anonymised inputs only. Exports an AP2 artifact with execution_hash for chain provenance. Open at: https://ainumbers.co/chaingraph/732-borrower-escrow-auditor.html FV-status (published/proven/still-trusted for this spec): /fv-status/ca4e1dca8343f788a296161f0e19712f7afb7e5eaec0431081e715a4cc34b784.json — a snapshot, not a subscription; this receipt verifies offline regardless of whether that file is ever fetched. Summary: Audits a servicer escrow accounting statement from borrower-supplied values only: recomputes the aggregate accounting trial running balance month by month, compares the servicer stated end-of-month balances line by line, flags each discrepant line, checks the stated cushion against the one-sixth-... Outputs: verdict, account_status, periods_analyzed, recomputed_balances, recomputed_low_point, target_low_point, total_annual_disbursements, cushion_cap_amount, stated_cushion, cushion_within_cap, shortage_amount, surplus_amount, shortage_threshold_base, shortage_threshold_base_source, shortage_at_or_above_one_month_payment, shortage_permitted_courses, servicer_course_permitted, surplus_refund_required, surplus_refund_unverified, discrepancies, evidence, manual_review_required. Output schema: call describe_tool("audit_borrower_escrow_stmt").

compute.description: Compute mode (v0.4 Compute Binding). "auto" (default) = server for gpu:false nodes with registered kernels; "server" = force server-side; "browser" = always return browser delegation URL. gpu:true nodes always delegate.

parent_hashes.description: execution_hash values from upstream ChainGraph AP2 artifacts to chain from (sets chain.parent_hashes in the export).

parent_tool_ids.description: tool_id values matching parent_hashes, in the same order.

policy_parameters.description: Input parameters for this tool's decision function. For gpu:false nodes with a registered kernel, these are computed server-side when compute is "auto" or "server". Required: starting_balance, monthly_payments, disbursements, stated_balances. Unknown keys are refused.
